plan.scaler: StandardScaler fit on training subjects only
plan.selection: Validation F2, then precision, smaller C, earlier gamma candidate, higher score threshold.
plan.score_transform: sigmoid(decision_function); display score only, NOT calibrated probability
plan.comparison_status: Exploratory comparison on previously inspected subjects 5-6. Not a new independent final test.

window_policy.target: Whether the supplied activity tag at the window endpoint is 1-5 (fall); 6-11 are non-fall.
window_policy.unknown_labels: Exclude any labelled training/evaluation window containing a tag outside 1-11.
window_policy.timing: Use original elapsed timestamps. Do not resample, interpolate, or cross recording boundaries.

window_metrics.note: Window-level metrics on overlapping causal windows; not independent event-level estimates.

event_metrics.protocol: Merge positive decisions within 2 s. Match alarm groups one-to-one to a known fall-tag interval through 1 s after its end. Exposure sums up to 0.25 s following each eligible window endpoint in non-fall trials. This is short laboratory exposure, before cancellation, and excludes unscored time.

limits: Exploratory comparison on previously inspected subjects 5-6. Not a new independent final test.
Only six participants and one trial per activity; overlapping windows are not independent events.
Laboratory belt data; no live hardware or construction-worker validation.
Unknown activity tags and unsuitable timing windows excluded by the original policy.
SVM scores are sigmoid-transformed margins, not calibrated probabilities or comparable confidence across models.
Accuracy alone can be misleading: only 56 of the 2,111 comparison windows are falls.
No settings were changed after this comparison. New participants are needed for a fresh final test.
Wearable memory, latency and energy use have not been measured.
